serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: The Eightfold Talent Intelligence Platform (TIP) is a SaaS solution that uses advanced AI to optimize every phase of the talent lifecycle including recruiting, retention, and workforce development. By centralizing talent operations and automating workflows, TIP helps public-sector agencies reduce costs, improve efficiency, and meet compliance requirements. TIP has varying capabilities or "modules" which can be used separately or together based on the specific needs of the organization. These modules include Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Talent Flex, Resource Management, Talent Tracking, and Workforce Exchange.
